card.summary: no service and no account; two Go programs built from source

free_tier.stated: no service and no account; two Go programs built from source

egress.terms: not applicable; the software states no volume; ingress: tcp

record.tooling: go build; server needs iptables and ip_forward
record.chaining: websocket mode rides the same class of forwarder as wstunnel; the server must sit on a host with a public address.
record.binding_note: the constraint is a Linux server with IP forwarding and MASQUERADE, outside the vocabulary

identity_cost.detail: No account required. Requires a Linux server with NAT rules and local deployment alongside a VPN endpoint.

record.reliability_note: client skips certificate verification in utls mode, stated in the README; last tagged build is from 2023
record.confidence_note: a measured run would raise it; the repository publishes no benchmark

evidence.proved: the description sentence, the two-binary layout, and the server requirements (WireGuard, Go, NAT rules, IP forwarding)
"The current client skips certificate verification" in utls mode
release v0.4.0 published 2023-09-10; last push 2026-09-27; 16 stars

record.notes: Open-source transport proxy using uTLS client hello shaping to bypass network inspection. Client and relay run as self-hosted components.

extras.wg_detail: "tunelo encrypts and tunnels UDP traffic (e.g. WireGuard) over a transport protocol like websocket or TCP"; server/ and client/ are separate binaries, both defaulting to websocket
extras.volume_stated: not applicable; the software states no volume
extras.hosting_requirement: a Linux server with a public address, IP forwarding and a NAT rule, plus the client binary on the device
